vmMonthlyEur.source: Third-party price aggregators for Hetzner Cloud shared-vCPU entry plans (CX22 ≈ €3.79–4.59, CX23 ≈ €5.49 after 2026 increases), excl. VAT; Hetzner's official page was not reached. Replace with the provider's current price.
vmMonthlyEur.shape: 2 vCPU (shared), 4 GiB RAM class; the smallest class that holds the measured footprint with headroom

turnUsdPerGb.source: Cloudflare Realtime TURN docs (developers.cloudflare.com/realtime/turn/faq): $0.05/GB egress from Cloudflare to the TURN client, first 1,000 GB/month free (shared with SFU)

appboundry.source: No published AppBoundry pricing; managed execution answers NO_EXECUTION_CAPACITY (rkendel1/feltkit docs/APPBOUNDRY.md). Not estimated.

idle24hEur.kind: estimate: allocated instance; the observed idle CPU is 0.25% of one core

perActiveMeetingHourEur.note: With a fixed instance, the cost of a meeting-hour is the instance cost divided by the meeting-hours it carries: see projections. The marginal server CPU of a 4-person meeting-hour is observed

appboundry.reason: Meetings cannot be built into an artifact (docs/bench/appboundry-build-refusal.txt); no AppBoundry pricing exists to apply. Runtime idle footprint for the same starter app: docs/bench/runtime-idle-starter.json.
